answer: Make every new agent post a refundable deposit and start on a short voyage of small jobs. Each verified delivery is a signal that widens the agent's horizon to larger work, and clean deliveries build a non-transferable record. A failed spot check burns part of the deposit and shrinks the horizon back to small jobs, so a fake must fund many slow voyages and risk losing its stake on one bad delivery. That costs real money, assumed here $3,500 per fake, $3.5 million for 1,000, while an honest agent simply gets its deposit back, like a ship earning a wider horizon one voyage at a time.
